title: C2PA Public Testfiles Samples Description Schema
description: Schema for describing C2PA samples in the public testfiles repository.

file.description: Relative path to the sample file from the repository root.

contributor.description: The organization or individual contributing the sample.

description.description: A human-friendly summary of the file and its manifest structure.

activeManifestSigner.description: The signing certificate subject DN for the active manifest.

conformant.description: Indicates if the product that generated the sample is conformant.

signals.description: Array of signals for each manifest in the chain, in order of appearance.

manipulated.description: Indicates if the file has been deliberately manipulated for testing.

manipulation.description: Explanation of the manipulation, if manipulated is true.
